title_zh: 说明胃部不适并等候检查

scenario.label_zh: 说明胃部不适并等候检查
scenario.goal_zh: 向护士描述胃部不适和体温并明确等待医生评估

context_zh: 奥马尔在诊所向护士说明胃部不适，等候医生评估原因。此为虚构就诊沟通，不作诊断。
author: author-phase04-c

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: My stomach has hurt since last night, and I feel hot.

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: I'll check your temperature. Have you been able to drink anything?

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: A little water. Could this be a virus?

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: We can't tell the cause from that alone. I'll record what you've told me for the doctor.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: All right. Where should I wait?

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: In this room, please. I'll let the doctor know you're ready.
